notes.title: Hackhub Devblog – Major Update 🚀
notes.notes:
🛠️ Note: This devblog showcases features that are still in development. They are not live yet, but will be part of upcoming updatesd.



Hello Hackers,

We’ve been working hard on Hackhub and we’re excited to share the latest progress with you. This update brings massive improvements to performance, stability, and gameplay depth. Let’s dive into what’s new:
[hr][/hr]🔧 Bug Fixes & Core Systems
Old programs system has been removed.

A brand new, high-performance Surfaces system has been implemented. All programs now run on this new system for smoother gameplay.

Terminal commands have been refactored for better reliability.

Node command & in-game scripting got major improvements, making scripting more stable and powerful.

Python3 command updated, with reworked scripts and brand new Python scripts added.

New terminal commands have been introduced.

Grep command has been added.

Dig command has been added.

MXLookup command added → DNS lookup queries can now be performed.
[hr][/hr]🌐 Tools & Features
Metasploit has been reworked with several improvements.

Web browser system redesigned for a better user experience.

New websites have been added to explore, including a GitHub website.

Pip package manager is now available for script management.

NTLM systems and hacking methods have been introduced.

Wireshark added → monitor data sharing between IPs.

System configs added → devices now behave according to their configuration settings.

Subfinder added → discover subdomains for pentesting.

Nuclei added → vulnerability scanning for pentesting.
(These tools are implemented similarly to their real-life pentesting counterparts.)
[hr][/hr]🖥️ Terminal Upgrades
You can now stop running commands in the terminal with Ctrl + C.

If text is selected → it copies to clipboard.

If no text is selected → it cancels the currently running process (for example, an unfinished lynx query).
[hr][/hr]🎮 Missions & Gameplay
The Journalist Sister mission series has been added.

New side missions have been added to expand your hacking journey.
[hr][/hr]⚡ Performance
Optimized game loading system – some packages are now preloaded during the loading screen for faster runtime performance.
[hr][/hr]🌍 Multiplayer Foundations
The very first steps of multiplayer have been implemented.

Currently, only a European server is live.

Account Center system has been introduced.
[hr][/hr]📂 Git System in Hackhub
A full Git system has been added!

Share your scripts with other players using real Git commands:

git init, git commit, git push, git clone, git pull

Keep your repos public to share, or private to store your scripts securely.
[hr][/hr]🌐 Networking Systems
Network system designed from scratch – every IP address now represents a real device connected to a network.

Wireshark monitoring → inspect data sharing between IPs in real time.

System configs → devices now behave according to their configuration settings.



Modem interface system added:

View existing ports.

Configure port forwarding.

Firewall system implemented:

Add or remove rules.

Even if a port is open, connections will fail if blocked by firewall rules.

To gain access, you’ll also need to hack into and modify firewall settings.
[hr][/hr]🎨 UI/UX Improvements
Main menu layout redesigned for a cleaner look.

Added a stats panel in the main menu so you can easily track your progress in the game.
[hr][/hr]
This update lays down the foundation for the future of Hackhub. Multiplayer and online systems are just getting started, and the new networking layer brings a whole new level of realism. We can’t wait to see how you’ll explore, exploit, and secure these systems.



Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - Hotfix

We've released a small hotfix addressing the following issues:

• 🌐 Handbook Crash Fix  
Fixed a bug causing the game to crash when opening the handbook in certain languages.

• 🕵️ Steal Exam Questions Quest Fix  
Resolved an issue where the “Search” objective in the "Steal Exam Questions" mission would not register as complete under certain conditions.

Thank you for reporting these issues — we're continuing to monitor feedback and improve stability!
